name: 무지개 양치식물실
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: No people, no text, no UI, cinematic child-friendly rainbow-fern conservatory, wide eye-level composition among rows of potted ferns each glowing a different rainbow hue, wet stone floor reflecting the colors below; open central path foreground, prismatic fern light blends with warm greenhouse lanterns, richly detailed frond texture, atmospheric humid haze, polished fantasy concept art, the whole conservatory glowing with painterly cinematic color.
